name: MCP-Universe
summary: Salesforce AI Research benchmark and framework that evaluates LLMs and agents on real-world tasks against live MCP servers, with a public leaderboard.
description: Domains include web search, location navigation, browser automation, financial analysis, repository management and 3D design, stressing long-horizon reasoning, large unfamiliar tool spaces and time-sensitive ground truth. The framework also runs the MCPMark tasks and ships agent tooling (MCP+ context wrapper, a deep-research agent). Paper: arXiv 2508.14704.
